title: ProjectConfig
description: cryptificate.json: what `cryptificate check` checks when it is run without input arguments. Relative paths are relative to the directory that holds this file. Options given on the command line override the values here.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editors. Ignored by cryptificate.

inputs.description: Design or request files, or patterns (*, ?, [..], **). Each pattern must match at least one file.

failOn.description: Claim statuses that fail the run, as --fail-on. Default refuted (the command-line default without this file is none).

claims.description: Claim ids the policy is restricted to, as --claims. Default: every claim the run attempts.

target.description: Circuit target applied to every input, as --target. Default: from each file.

output.description: File the formatted result is written to, as --output.

bundleDir.description: Directory that receives one evidence bundle per input, as --bundle-dir.
